title: Mongo: chaos process-kill + auto-heal
description: Runs `nexus chaos mongo process-kill`: pushes nexus-chaos.sh, kills nexus-mongo on a secondary for a time-boxed window, observes impact mid-window, lifts, and confirms recovery to green.

observe.what: target=<secondary>; observed-impact table shows that member failed + quorum 2/3 + 1 PRIMARY held; cluster recovered to GREEN after lift

whatProves: MongoAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync injects a time-boxed self-reverting fault via the embedded nexus-chaos.sh, observes RS impact, and confirms auto-heal.
